layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense, Data Correlation). 1px solid borders for separation.

cards.style: Flat background, 1px subtle border (#E4E4E7), no default shadow. Sharp corners or subtle rounded-md.

buttons.primary: bg-[#09090B] text-white hover:bg-[#27272A] rounded-md px-6 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-[#FF4F00] text-white hover:bg-[#E64700] rounded-md px-6 py-2 transition-colors

tables.header: bg-[#F4F4F5] text-[#71717A] text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold

motion.list_stagger: framer-motion standard stagger for list items

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup fonts: Include Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi via Fontshare CDN in index.html: <link href="https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@800,500,700,400&f[]=satoshi@900,700,500,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
2. Modify tailwind.config.js to set font-sans to Satoshi and font-heading to Cabinet Grotesk.
3. Build the layout with a Sidebar (left) and Main Content (right).

4. Main Content Logic: Check if there are 'Pendientes'. If yes, take the closest one (by Hora Estimada) and render it in a massive 'Cruce Actual' Card at the top (F-pattern focus). Use the accent color (#FF4F00) if it is an 'URGENCIA'.
5. The remaining 'Pendientes' go into a 'Siguientes Pendientes' table/list below the main card.
6. Use Shadcn components for Dialogs (Create/Edit), Select (Service Type), Tables, and Dropdown Menus (Actions).
7. Include 'Marcar como hecho' (Mark as done) button prominently on the 'Cruce Actual' card.
8. Implement filtering by Status and Service Type.
9. Use Phosphor Icons for a clean, technical look (e.g., Truck, MapPin, Clock, Warning).
10. All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
